verses.text: In those days John the Baptist came and began preaching in the desert of Judea.
He said, "Turn away from your sins, because the kingdom of heaven is near!"
John is the one the prophet Isaiah spoke about when he said, "I am the voice of someone shouting in the desert, 'Get the road ready for the Lord! Make straight paths for him!'"
John wore clothes made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
People came out to him from Jerusalem, from all of Judea and from the whole area around the Jordan River.
They told about their sins, and John baptised them in the Jordan River.
But many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to where he was baptising. When John saw them, he said, "You family of snakes! Who warned you to run away from God's anger that is coming?
Show by the way you live that you have really turned away from your sins.
And do not think you can say to yourselves, 'Abraham is our father.' I tell you, God can make children for Abraham out of these stones.
The axe is already at the roots of the trees. Every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

"I baptise you with water to show that you have turned away from your sins. But someone is coming after me who is more powerful than I am. I am not good enough even to carry his sandals. He will baptise you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
He holds a winnowing fork in his hand to clear his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but he will burn up the husks with a fire that never goes out."
Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River to be baptised by John.
But John tried to stop him. He said, "I need to be baptised by you, so why are you coming to me?"
Jesus answered, "Let it be this way for now. It is right for us to do everything that God wants." Then John agreed.
As soon as Jesus was baptised, he came up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and landing on him.
And a voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, whom I love. I am very pleased with him."
